verdict.rationale: Fidelity's Growth plan lists '409A valuations' as an included feature, but its own docs clarify that 409A reports come from third-party valuation providers rather than being generated automatically in-platform from live cap table data (docs-16, docs-28). There is no evidence of automated refresh scheduling or direct cap-table-to-valuation generation as the story describes. Missing for 10: evidence of in-platform automated 409A generation tied to live cap table data, scheduled/refresh automation, and audit-ready certification details.
